sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Domestic and family violence can be confusing and overwhelming. This lesson helps parents understand what DFV actually is and why recognising it matters.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: DFV includes emotional, physical, financial, sexual, and psychological abuse. It is about power and control, not anger or conflict.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn how to identify patterns of behaviour that signal risk, including isolation, intimidation, and monitoring.
